slides.title: Executive summary

paragraphs.text: Executive summary
Enter the US in 2027 through Amazon, the one route within all board limits, and add retail only after a 20% awareness gate
The US is worth the 2027 slot: K-beauty is booming and the pilot shows demand
–	US K-beauty skincare reached $3.6B, growing about 4 times as fast as the category
–	Pilot units nearly doubled in six months at 4.5 stars, with 29% repeat
A retail-led launch breaks the board's limits even on its own assumptions
–	On its own numbers it needs $20.8M by 2030, above the $18M cap
–	At Onsoo's awareness, newcomers sell 2.6 units a door a week; 4.0 is required
The Amazon-led route needs little cash, but payback needs ACoS below 28.6%
–	Peak cash need is $1.9M, or $3.2M at a 32% ACoS that delays payback
Only Amazon-led stays within every board limit, with nearly 4 times Japan's revenue
–	It reaches $26.4M in 2030; no route reaches $40M by 2030
–	Japan stays within limits but adds only $7.0M of revenue in 2030
Launch in 2027 with gates: retail after 20% awareness and $10M Amazon sales
–	Set up in H1 2027, launch on Amazon in H2, review retail gates end-2028
